_comment: Pinned test-population expectation. Guards against silent contraction of the evidence base (F-M2-1). `population` maps every node id to its declared resource markers; every set below is mechanically derivable from it, so counts are never the primary record. The marker populations OVERLAP -- upstream and torch share 23 node ids -- so their counts must never be summed. Resource markers OVERLAP; their counts must never be summed. `job_ownership` names the job that must EXECUTE each marker's nodes -- a null owner means those node ids execute nowhere, which is a blocking evidence failure and is not suppressible by `open_evidence_gaps`. Update only through a reviewed commit.

measured_under.note: Pinned from a fully provisioned environment: scripts/patch_upstream.py applied to the clone at upstream_commit, torch and matplotlib installed, and the GO Stanford corpus present. CI reproduces that environment across three jobs -- the hermetic matrix, upstream-compat, and go-stanford-corpus -- whose populations partition this one.

ordinary_leg._comment: Hermetic legs are explicitly NOT the owner of the resource population. Of the 72 resource node ids, 20 are collectable without provisioning and are DESELECTED by marker; the other 52 live in modules that cannot import at all without their resource, so they are never collected here. Deselected and not-collected are different states and are pinned separately. The 20/52 split is read from the population report a hermetic job uploads, not assumed.
ordinary_leg.selects: not torch and not upstream and not plot and not go_stanford

open_evidence_gaps.reason: skips on REPO/.venv-m1/bin/python, a gitignored developer path that cannot exist in a clean checkout

go_stanford.status: CLOSED -- owned and executed by a provisioned job
go_stanford.execution_anywhere: go-stanford-corpus, which fails rather than skips when the corpus is absent
go_stanford.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (non-commercial); this repository is MIT, so corpus bytes are never committed and are fetched at test time
go_stanford.corpus_digest_provenance: sha256 of the released zip; equals the LFS oid the dataset host reports, and equals the local copy the F13 shape finding was measured on
go_stanford.members_required: */traj_data.pkl -- 3696 files, 15.9 MB of the 781.7 MB archive. The owned node never opens an image, so the job extracts only these and caches them under the archive digest.
